name: vroom
description: Mobile-first Skia candlestick chart library — monorepo root

scripts.test:core: cmake -S packages/core -B packages/core/build -DVROOM_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build packages/core/build --target vroom_tests && ctest --test-dir packages/core/build --output-on-failure

pnpm.//: Security floors for transitives stuck behind docusaurus/expo/tsup parents. Each override is temporary — delete it once the parent ships a fixed range (pnpm why <pkg> to check).

auditConfig.//: image-size has no fixed release — every version through 2.0.2 (the latest) is affected, so there is nothing to pin. Both advisories are parser denial-of-service reached only at build time, via docusaurus's mdx-loader and expo's metro, on images from this repo; neither path ships in a published package. Drop these once docusaurus/expo pick up a fixed image-size.
